title: Joomla Extension - onlinecommunityhub.nl - Server-side request forgery via remote image address check bypass in…
description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in the ochResponsiveImages Joomla extension versions 1.0.0 through 4.2.0. The vulnerability arises because the extension's remote image address check improperly follows redirects without validating them, only resolves IPv4 addresses, and is susceptible to DNS rebinding. When the "Include Remote Images" feature is enabled, an attacker with content author privileges could exploit this to make the server fetch internal network resources and cache them publicly. This issue is fixed in version 4.2.1.
